address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x20`.

*See also: [PCA9554 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pca9554#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this `pca9554` component.

*See also: [PCA9554 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pca9554#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the INT output of the PCA9554/PCA9535. When configured, the component becomes interrupt-driven instead of polling — it only reads the chip when a pin actually changes state, significantly reducing I²C bus traffic and CPU usage. The INT pin is active-low and open-drain, so an external or internal pull-up resistor is required. Must be an internal GPIO pin (not another expander pin).

*See also: [PCA9554 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pca9554#configuration-variables)*

pin_count.docs:
**int**: The number of bits implemented in the expander. Defaults to 8. This should be set to 16 when using a PCA9535 and 4 when using a PCA9536.

*See also: [PCA9554 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pca9554#configuration-variables)*
